description.fun: A stork that wears an apron made from its own shed feathers. Real storks are said to deliver babies; Bombirdier bundles up rocks and other things in its apron instead, and drops them from high up for fun, especially anything that makes a loud noise. It also uses the apron to carry food home to its nest. A giant one, the Open Sky Titan, lives in Paldea's West Province.
description.guide: A Flying and Dark-type stork Pokémon from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet that gathers objects in a feather apron and drops them from the sky. It plays on the folklore of storks delivering babies. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A stork that drops rocks instead of babies
